https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-new.text: The influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate were arrested Saturday in Miami after the U.K. sought their extradition on dozens of charges, including rape and sex trafficking.The Tates, who are brothers, have millions of followers on X, where they promote a pugnacious, hypermasculine lifestyle that rejects feminism. The arrests were before Andrew Tate, a former kickboxing champion, was supposed to serve as co-host of a bare-knuckle boxing event in Miami.British prosecutors said Saturday the brothers are facing a total of 59 charges for alleged offenses that took place between 2010 and 2017.The U.S. Marshals Service said the ”arrests were made in accordance with the treaties and law enforcement agreements governing Justice Department extraditions.” The brothers are expected to make an appearance at a Florida federal court early next week, according to a law-enforcement official.Joseph McBride, a lawyer for the brothers, said the Tates are innocent.“Andrew and Tristan Tate will walk free,” McBride said Saturday. “America does not do Britain’s political dirty work. Not here. Never.”The U.K.’s Crown Prosecution Service said it authorized 42 charges against Andrew Tate, who is 39 years old. Tristan Tate, 38, faces 17 charges. The service said there are a total of seven alleged victims.In 2016, Andrew Tate was kicked off a British reality show after a video surfaced that appeared to show him repeatedly hitting a woman with a belt. The brothers, who have British and American citizenship, later moved to Romania, where they have also been charged with rape and human trafficking.Andrew Tate has styled himself as a self-help guru for young men and criticizes a Western culture that denigrates the traditional role of men in society.Write to Joseph Pisani at joseph.pisani@wsj.com and Sadie Gurman at sadie.gurman@wsj.com

Russian forces launched a series of missile and drone strikes against Ukraine on the night of August 8 to 9. The Ukrainian Air Force reported that Russian forces launched 17 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles, Onyx anti-ship missiles, and Kh-31P anti-radar missiles from occupied Crimea and the Black Sea region and 202 Shahed-type, Gerbera-type, and Parodiya-type drones and Banderol loitering munitions from the directions of Kursk and Oryol cities; Millerovo, Rostov Oblast; Primorsko-Akhtarsk, Krasnodar Krai; occupied Donetsk City; and occupied Hvardiiske, Crimea .[80] The Ukrainian Air Force reported that Ukrainian forces downed 174 drones and five Banderols, that missiles and drones hit 22 locations, and that missile debris fell on six locations. The Ukrainian Air Force added that several missiles did not reach their intended targets. Ukrainian officials reported that Russian forces struck residential, energy, commercial, agricultural, rail, and port infrastructure in Odesa, Kharkiv, Zhytomyr, Mykolaiv, Kyiv, Kherson, Sumy, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhia, Chernihiv, and Donetsk oblasts.[81] Ukrainian Minister of Internal Affairs Ivan Vyhivksyi reported on August 9 that Russian forces conducted a double-tap strike during the day on August 9 against Ukrainian emergency workers responding to the overnight Russian strikes in Zaporizhia Oblast, killing a firefighter.[82] Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated on August 9 that Russian forces continue to heavily rely on ballistic missiles in their strike packages against Ukraine as part of efforts to exploit Ukrainian shortages of interceptor missiles.[83] Zelensky stated that Russian forces launched 61 missiles, including 56 ballistic missiles; more than 1,560 strike drones; and 1,540 glide bombs against Ukraine between August 3 and 9. 135 of 151 Russian drones were shot down or suppressed overnight, Ukraine's Air Force says. Russia also launched six Iskander-M ballistic missiles and S-400 missiles. Missile and 13 drone hits were recorded at 12 locations, with debris falling at 7. The aggressor launched one missile strike, fired nine missiles, carried out 66 airstrikes using 211 guided aerial bombs, deployed 6,347 kamikaze drones for attacks, and carried out 2,114 shelling attacks on the positions of our troops and populated areas. In the Northern Slobozhanshchyna and Kursk sectors, two combat engagements have taken place since the start of the day; the enemy carried out 41 shelling attacks on the positions of our troops and populated areas. Over the past 24 hours in the Southern Slobozhansky direction, the enemy launched 12 assaults on the positions of our units in the areas around the settlements of Starytsia, Vovchansk, and Artilne, as well as toward the settlements of Izbytske, Volokhivka, Kupyne, and Khatne. Seven engagements are ongoing. In the Sloviansk sector, the Defense Forces successfully halted seven attempts by the invaders to advance in the area of Riznykivka and toward Rai-Oleksandrivka. In the Kramatorsk sector, Russian invaders carried out three attacks in the area of Nykyforivka and toward Yurkivka. In the Kostiantynivka sector, the Defense Forces repelled 24 enemy assaults in the areas around the settlements of Kostiantynivka and Illinivka, as well as toward the settlements of Dovha Balka and Mykolaypillya. Two firefights are ongoing. The enemy carried out 19 attacks in the Pokrovsk sector. The occupiers attempted to advance in the areas around the settlements of Novooleksandrivka, Kotlyne, Udachne, and Molodetske, as well as toward the settlements of Kucheryv Yar, Nove Shakhove, Shevchenko, Svitle, Serhiivka, Muravka, Matyashieve, and Novopavlivka. Two firefights are still ongoing. According to preliminary estimates, 40 occupiers were killed and 20 wounded today; one artillery system, a fuel and lubricants depot, 25 enemy personnel shelters, and three UAV command posts were destroyed. Three artillery systems, six vehicles, two pieces of specialized equipment, 13 UAV command posts, and 120 enemy personnel shelters were damaged. A total of 390 unmanned aerial vehicles of various types were destroyed or neutralized. In the Oleksandrivka sector, the enemy launched three attacks toward Danilivka and Novozhorzhia. In the Huliaipil sector, the Defense Forces repelled 17 enemy attacks toward the settlements of Vozdvyzhivka, Hirke, Huliaipilsk, Rivne, and Tsvitkove. Two firefights are ongoing. In the Orikhiv sector, our defenders repelled two enemy attempts to advance toward Primorske and in the Plavni area. In the Dnipro sector, the enemy did not conduct any offensive operations. In other areas, there have been no significant changes in the situation. Let’s defeat the enemy and bring our Victory closer! Glory to Ukraine! https://hotnews.ro/un-roman-a-fost-ranit.text: Printre cele zeci de persoane rănite în accidentul produs marți pe autostrada Trakia se află și un cetățean român, care beneficiază în prezent de îngrijiri medicale. Anunțul a fost făcut marți de ministrul Afacerilor Externe, Dan Neculăescu, printr-un mesaj publicat pe platforma X. „Printre răniții din tragicul accident rutier produs în Bulgaria se află și un cetățean român, care beneficiază în prezent de îngrijiri medicale. Echipele noastre consulare sunt pregătite să ofere asistență”, a afirmat ministrul. Șeful diplomației române a transmis un mesaj de solidaritate pentru victimele tragediei din țara vecină. „Exprimăm cele mai sincere condoleanțe în urma tragicului accident produs pe o autostradă din Bulgaria. Gândurile noastre se îndreaptă către victime, familiile acestora și toți cei afectați de această tragedie. Le urăm celor răniți o însănătoșire completă și rapidă”, a mai scris Neculăescu. Cel puțin 11 persoane și-au pierdut viața, iar alte 48 au fost rănite marți în cele două accidente în lanț în care au fost implicate 86 de vehicule pe ambele sensuri ale autostrăzii Trakia, în sud-estul Bulgariei. Traficul în zonă este blocat și deviat pe rute ocolitoare, iar primele date ale autorităților bulgare arată posibila cauză a accidentului .
